items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: Half Plane, I think I remember. It's a long time ago.

ctx.x: Do you remember Half Plane Jackson, Frankie Jackson? Singer and entertainer, you know?
I think your name is familiar. Maybe I do. A little short, then. Half Plane, I think I remember. It's a long time ago.
I just wondered who was in those reviews.
